summary: Stabilized the flaky `ServiceDetailsView.instant-buy` harness and advanced the local service gates. The instant-buy component suite now caches the heavy `ServiceDetailsView` import once per file instead of recompiling it per test, uses an explicit `beforeAll` hook timeout for that cold-start path, and aligns the success-path assertions with the component’s async timing. With that in place, `src/lib/tests/components/service/ServiceDetailsView.instant-buy.test.ts` is green in isolation again, the broader component aggregate `src/lib/tests/components/service/ src/lib/tests/components/dashboard/ src/lib/tests/components/homepage/` is green, and the targeted homepage/SEO/docs slice is green. The updated `.gitlab-ci.yml` service gate jobs now cover the intended TEST-G3 task/service regression slice and TEST-G4 visual slice command patterns, but CI-G1 is still only partially satisfied because deterministic E2E environment/bootstrap checks and merge-policy verification are not yet encoded in the pipeline. `git diff --check` still reports a pre-existing unrelated trailing-whitespace issue in `src/lib/stores/profile.store.ts` that I did not change.
remaining_work: Add deterministic CI-side E2E environment/bootstrap validation to fully satisfy `CI-G1`, including required service E2E env contracts rather than only the Playwright command slices.
Run and verify the remaining Playwright/visual gate suites in a ready environment for the service quote, UX-hardening, instant-buy, homepage featured-services, and task/service regression flows.
Finish the remaining TEST-G3/TEST-G4 evidence pass after the CI/bootstrap gap is closed, and address any follow-on failures surfaced by those browser runs.
